parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The current value reading of this {{object}} in units defined in {{param|Unit}}.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when {{param|Value}} has been changed to the current value.

parameters.name: LastContactTime
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when the {{object}} has received data.

parameters.name: LowLevel
parameters.description: Low level indicator. Is set to {{true}} if {{param|Value}} is equal or less than the value defined in {{param|LowLevelThreshold}}.

parameters.name: LowLevelThreshold
parameters.description: The threshold value in for {{param|LowLevel}} expressed in the same units like {{param|Value}}.

parameters.name: HighLevel
parameters.description: High level indicator. Is set to {{true}} if {{param|Value}} is equal or higher than the value defined in {{param|HighLevelThreshold}}.

parameters.name: HighLevelThreshold
parameters.description: The threshold value in for {{param|HighLevel}} expressed in the same units like {{param|Value}}.

object.description: LevelSensor is used to reflect the functionality of a sensor that reports a {{param|Value}} in {{param|Unit}}.
